name: Text.Uppercase
summary: Converts all letters in the input to uppercase.

name: Text.Trim
summary: Removes supported whitespace characters from both ends of the input.
details: The implementation trims control characters through space, DEL, and no-break space.

name: Text.SplitByLength
summary: Splits text into lines containing up to the requested number of characters.

name: Text.SoundEx
summary: Returns a phonetic SoundEx code for the input.

name: Text.RightTrim
summary: Removes supported whitespace characters from the end of the input.

name: Text.Reverse
summary: Reverses the order of Unicode code points in the input.

name: Text.ReplaceNewline
summary: Replaces newline characters according to the selected mode and wrapping width.
details: The exact mode mapping is implemented by the local text helper; compatibility beyond checked cases is unverified.
differences: No deterministic example is included because the mode options require further compatibility confirmation.

name: Text.ReplaceAll
summary: Replaces every occurrence of the search text with the replacement.

name: Text.RemovePrefix
summary: Removes a matching prefix when it occurs at the start of the input.

name: Text.RemovePostfix
summary: Removes a matching postfix when it occurs at the end of the input.

name: Text.RemoveNewline
summary: Removes carriage return and line feed characters from text.

name: Text.RemoveControlCharacters
summary: Removes selected control characters from the input.
details: Tab, carriage return, and line feed are retained by this implementation.

name: Text.RemoveAccentsCaseInsensitive
summary: Removes supported accents and returns the resulting text in uppercase.
